This creates a coherent exploration narrative: follow the path → find the building → spot the light → discover the hidden chest.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task — the player must navigate close enough to the brick building (centered at Z+13, Y+1) and face it. max_distance=8 allows the player to 'find' the building from a reasonable viewing distance as they approach along the slab path.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task — the player must enter the building and look toward the jack_o_lantern on the ceiling at (0, +2, +13). max_distance=5 ensures the player is inside or at the doorway. facing_tolerance=75 is generous to account for the upward pitch needed to look at a ceiling-mounted block.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task — the player must locate the trapped chest on the floor at the back-right of the building interior (+2, 0, +14). max_distance=5 ensures the player is inside the building. facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is looking toward the chest.
